test_cases.description: Verify that all global flags are registered with correct defaults and that --version prints the embedded version string and exits 0.

test_cases.description: Verify that StatusSpinner writes animated spinner output to stderr only and does not write to stdout.

test_cases.description: Verify that all StatusSpinner methods are no-ops and produce no output when --quiet is set or AF_AGENT=1.

property_tests.description: For any SIGINT or SIGTERM received during any AI-calling command, the context is cancelled, the StatusSpinner is stopped, and the binary exits with code 1 without goroutine leaks.
